items.headline: KERC true-up order: BESCOM tariff up 56 paise/unit from May 2026
items.detail: KERC issued a true-up tariff order covering revenue shortfalls from FY2024-25. BESCOM permitted to raise tariffs by 56 paise/unit; CESC (Mysuru) by 15 paise/unit. Effective for electricity consumed May 1, 2026 - Apr 30, 2027. Some other ESCOMs (MESCOM, HESCOM, GESCOM, HRECS) directed to refund surplus revenue to consumers instead.

raw_values.note_for_trader_relevance: This is a RETAIL tariff change (what consumers pay ESCOMs), not a wholesale/DAM price change. Low direct relevance to day-ahead trading; included mainly as background context on ESCOM financial health and demand-side cost pressure. Flag this distinction for your synthesis agent so it doesn't conflate retail tariff moves with wholesale price signals.
raw_values.relevance_classification_reason: Retail/consumer-facing tariff or code change -- kept as demand-side context, not a wholesale signal

items.headline: KERC opens public hearing on solar tariff framework for 2026-2029
items.detail: Public notice issued July 2, 2026 announcing a hearing to determine tariff and regulatory framework for solar power projects (including Distributed Solar PV) for the control period July 1, 2026 - June 30, 2029. Covers multiple categories of solar generators and various metering arrangements.

raw_values.note_for_trader_relevance: Procedural/consultative stage, not yet a binding order. Low near-term market relevance; worth tracking as it develops toward a final order, since solar tariff changes affect merit-order generation economics over the control period.
raw_values.relevance_classification_reason: Procedural/consultative stage (hearing/draft/notice), not yet a binding order -- kept as low-priority watch item regardless of subject matter

items.headline: KERC issues draft amendment to Karnataka Electricity Distribution Code
items.detail: Draft First Amendment to the Karnataka Electricity Distribution Code (KEDC) 2026 gazetted June 11, 2026; public hearing notice issued July 3, 2026. Hearing held July 14, 2026 at KERC's Bengaluru office. Amendment addresses distribution/supply standards, metering, and grid-integration rules relevant to renewable and open-access connections.

raw_values.scope: Distribution Code: metering, billing, technical connection standards, grid integration
raw_values.note_for_trader_relevance: Operational/technical rulemaking, not a price signal by itself. Relevant mainly for medium-term grid-integration and open-access rule changes rather than day-ahead trading decisions.
raw_values.relevance_classification_reason: Procedural/consultative stage (hearing/draft/notice), not yet a binding order -- kept as low-priority watch item regardless of subject matter
